description: The free `echo` channel is a managed static endpoint reached on the canonical gateway URL; the metered `plus` channel is per-enrollment, each enrollment binding its own upstream `base_url` (and optional API key) via parameters and reached at its own `/e/<code>` URL. Demonstrates channel-based pricing and an enrollable plus channel co-existing with a free open channel.
name: multi-channel
summary: Multi-channel HTTP relay: one offering exposing two upstream access channels.
